title: The Rivergate of the Sepik Basin
author: Oscar Sandoval
blurb: August Dunmore, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the concession permits expire.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
